prompt: Production app icon edit. Use ONLY the bottom-left small approved purple app icon in the board. Output ONLY that icon at 1024x1024 pixels, full-bleed opaque purple square, no rounded corners. Preserve the exact same mascot from that small icon: mint asymmetric body, two cream white leaves (not purple), cream oval eyes dark pupils looking upper-right, dark small curved smile, two small feet. Preserve shape and placement of every feature exactly. Icon mascot occupies ~65% width and ~74% height, centered with breathing room. Background is uniform purple #6650CD covering the entire square to all edges. Flat crisp graphic, no texture no gradients no shine no glow no shadows. No text, no border, no inset tile, no rounded corners, no frame. Do not use the big central horizontal logo mascot as the source.
